title: Command Shell Font Rhythm Refinement
purpose: Make VedaPath feel more cohesive by reducing type spread, weight contrast, and repeated surface noise across the command shell.
rules: Keep release-room heroes below the old oversized display tier.
Give answer titles their own middle tier instead of card-title sizing.
Reduce metric and badge weight so they support the reading path.
Keep rail labels compact and repeatable across all rooms.
Use fixed font sizes rather than viewport-width scaling.
Keep letter spacing at zero for calmer reading.
acceptance_notes: Home and room pages should feel related without identical scale.
Cards should read as supporting surfaces, not competing headlines.
Answer, source, practice, and review pages should share one typographic rhythm.
